description: A script for listing MISP sightings, retrieving data from the MISP API, and optionally emailing a report. It includes functions for managing timestamps, searching sightings, and sending email reports, with specific focus on the 'show_sightings.py' example script.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes and returns a PyMISP object with provided URL, key, and verification setting.

methods.name: set_drift_timestamp
methods.description: Saves a timestamp to a specified file.

methods.name: get_drift_timestamp
methods.description: Reads a timestamp from a specified file, defaulting to 0 if unavailable.

methods.name: search_sightings
methods.description: Searches for sightings within a specified time range, fetching related attribute and event details.
